series.name: microSpread
series.description: Quoted bid-ask spread of the symbol, in basis points of the mid price.

series.name: microBookEvents
series.description: Order-book activity per bar near the touch: size added by new limit orders and size cancelled (both BTC), and order flow imbalance (signed BTC, positive when bids grow or asks shrink).

series.name: execFills
series.description: Child-order fills of an execution algorithm, quantity per bar (BTC).

series.name: execStrategy
series.description: Daily results of a trading strategy: gross equity before costs (a multiple of the starting capital) and turnover (traded notional as a multiple of equity).

series.name: xexVenues
series.description: The symbol's price on two other venues (Exchange B at a small premium, Exchange C lagging slightly), in the quote currency.

events.name: execSlippage
events.description: Fills of an execution desk; value: slippage against the arrival mid, in basis points (positive is a cost).

events.name: execQuoteFills
events.description: Buy fills of a liquidity-taking algorithm; value: fill price against the best ask, in basis points (positive is worse than the quote).

events.name: execBuySignals
events.description: Buy signals of a strategy; value: delay from the signal to the fill, in seconds.
